meta.name: IBM Cloud drift detection & correction planning (synthetic)

data.label: Platform reviewer
data.description: The person who reviews the diff and approves or rejects it. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Synthetic cloud inventory
data.description: Synthetic resource inventory fixture (JSON) used for qualification. Not a real IBM account.

data.label: Read-only credentials
data.description: Holds the API key for a read-only Service ID (Viewer/Reader roles only). The system never asks for broader credentials or creates them on its own.

data.label: Inventory collector
data.description: Read-only job that normalises the inventory into a snapshot. Locally it reads the synthetic fixture. Against a real account it would call read-only Resource Controller/Global Search APIs.

data.label: Snapshot & baseline store
data.description: Versioned bucket holding inventory snapshots, the desired-state baseline, plans and diffs. No delete path is granted to the pipeline.

data.label: Drift detector
data.description: Deterministic comparison of the latest snapshot with the baseline. Emits a list of drift findings.

data.label: Policy checks
data.description: Evaluates the snapshot against policy rules, e.g. encryption, public access and tags. Results are deterministic and independent of the model.
data.service: IBM Cloud Code Engine (OPA policy-as-code); IBM Cloud Security and Compliance Center for real accounts

data.label: Correction planner
data.description: Turns drift and policy findings into a proposed Terraform change with an explanation. Its output is untrusted until it passes the policy checks again. Locally a scripted mock answers, which proves nothing about real model quality.

data.label: Plan generator (plan only)
data.description: Runs terraform plan on the proposed change in a Schematics workspace. The pipeline identity is not granted apply or destroy actions.

data.label: Diff review & approval
data.description: Shows the plan diff, findings and rationale. The reviewer approves or rejects, and the decision is recorded. Approval does not trigger an apply in this scope.
data.service: IBM Cloud Code Engine (app) + IBM Cloud App ID sign-in

data.label: Audit trail
data.description: Records every collection, check, model call, plan and approval decision with actor and timestamp.
data.service: IBM Cloud Activity Tracker Event Routing + IBM Cloud Logs

brief.application: Use IBM Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Analyze a synthetic cloud inventory and propose an infrastructure correction. Include read-only inventory, policy checks, plan generation, a reviewable diff and approval/audit controls. Detect drift. Never apply, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

lastAsked.question: What information will it work with, and where does it live?
lastAsked.beginner: For example a database, documents, or another system's data.
lastAsked.why: It shapes the AI architecture design.

requirements.statement: The system must never apply changes, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically. It may only produce plans and diffs for human review.
requirements.rationale: An automated change could damage live infrastructure. Plan-only access with human approval limits that risk.
requirements.basis: User: "Never apply, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically."

requirements.statement: Detect drift between the inventory snapshot and an agreed desired-state baseline, and run policy checks that produce findings feeding a reviewable correction diff.
requirements.rationale: Without a defined baseline, drift findings are ambiguous. The baseline source is still an open question.
requirements.basis: User: "Detect drift"; "Include read-only inventory, policy checks, plan generation, a reviewable diff"

requirements.statement: Record every inventory read, model call, plan and approval decision with actor and timestamp.
requirements.rationale: Reviewers need evidence of who approved what, and on which inputs. Retention period is still to be confirmed.

decisions.subject: design.ibm-cloud-read-only-drift-correction-planning-sketch
decisions.title: IBM Cloud read-only drift & correction-planning sketch
decisions.context: End-to-end flow: synthetic inventory → read-only collector → versioned snapshot → drift + policy checks → watsonx.ai correction proposal → Schematics plan-only → reviewable diff → human approval, with Activity Tracker/Cloud Logs audit. No apply/delete path exists; credentials are read-only and held in Secrets Manager. Assumptions: region, account, IBM plans and model access are unselected and unverified; the inventory is synthetic; the model is mocked in local tests. Native Terraform generation for these IBM components is not yet available, so engineering is still needed.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.
